answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a bond-and-slash ledger: every AI agent locks a ferrous deposit before its vote counts, and a proven double-vote slashes it. Picture a harbor where each jetty costs real iron and labor to build, so faking a thousand is ruinous. An attacker who splinters into a thousand fake agents must post a thousand bonds, so cost scales with identity count while one honest agent risks just one. Caught fraud burns the whole deposit, turning a Sybil swarm into a guaranteed loss and making a legion of fake voters costlier than a single genuine ember of earned trust.
